svg.title: Crunch mesh and texture dependency repair
svg.desc: Missing ParagonCrunch dependencies for the active Crunch V4 skeletal mesh were copied into a target-owned package closure, references were remapped, and Unreal load probes passed.

g.text: Crunch · mesh and texture dependency repair
2026-09-10 · target-owned V4 presentation assets restored from the available source checkout
SM_CrunchV4 referenced /Game/ParagonCrunch/... packages that were not present in AuraProj/Content.
Logs: 2 material classes + 5 MICs + Crunch_Extents + Crunch_ShadowCyl skipped as unavailable.
Source Crunch-master packages were scanned recursively from the mesh/material seeds.
82 .uasset packages · 493.3 MiB · 43 texture packages · 9 material packages
Copied to /Game/Assets/Crunch/... and byte-preserving references remapped to the target prefix.
All repaired target packages: legacy prefix references = 0 · Unreal load probe = 3/3
The old AM_Dash/AM_UpperCut legacy animation warnings remain outside this mesh/texture repair.
Validation: Fast Assets preflight PASS · combo commandlet PASS · direct Unreal/Python asset probe PASS · diff check clean.
